sdk.//rollForward: latestFeature, not latestPatch: the Dockerfile builds on the floating `sdk:10.0` image, which has since moved to the 10.0.3xx feature band. latestPatch refuses to cross a feature band, so the container build failed with 'A compatible .NET SDK was not found' while the host build was fine.
sdk.//allowPrerelease: Previews stay out, so an installed 10.0.4xx-preview cannot silently become the build SDK on a developer machine.
